title: Policies & Terms
subtitle: Protecting customer interests and ensuring complete peace of mind for audiophiles
contactSupport: Questions about our policies? Contact Hotline / Zalo at 0931 772 150 for direct assistance.

shipping.title: Shockproof Shipping Policy
shipping.content: Specialized multi-layer protective packaging designed specifically for tube amplifiers and fragile audio gear.

details.heading: 1. Dedicated Packaging for Tube Amplifiers & Vacuum Tubes
details.text: All vacuum tubes are removed and individually numbered, packed in bubble wrap, and stored in dedicated shock-resistant boxes. The amplifier chassis is cushioned with high-density foam on all 6 sides inside a heavy-duty 5-layer corrugated box reinforced with corner guards.

details.heading: 2. Coverage & Couriers
details.text: We ship nationwide via Viettel Post / VNPost with 100% full declared value insurance. Within Ho Chi Minh City (especially Thu Duc City area), we offer direct doorstep delivery with setup and testing upon request.

details.heading: 3. Delivery Times
details.text: HCMC: 2-4 hours express or same-day delivery. Other provinces: 2-4 business days. You will receive a tracking code to follow shipment status directly on our website.

details.heading: 4. Inspection on Delivery
details.text: Customers have the right to inspect exterior package condition, amplifier cosmetics, tubes, and included accessories before signing delivery acceptance.

warranty.title: Warranty Policy
warranty.content: Clear warranty terms and lifelong technical support for both brand new and vintage equipment.

details.heading: 1. Warranty Periods
details.text:
• Brand New: 12 months for chassis/circuitry, 3 months for vacuum tubes.
• Like New / Vintage: 6 months for chassis/circuitry, 1 month for vacuum tubes.
• After warranty: Lifetime bias adjustment, tube testing, and discounted repair services.

details.heading: 2. Warranty Eligibility
details.text: Products must retain intact store warranty seals and chassis screw seals with no unauthorized circuit tampering or external modifications.

details.heading: 3. Exclusions
details.text: Physical drops, liquid spills, overvoltage burns (e.g., plugging 100V-115V gear directly into 220V mains without a step-down transformer), lightning strikes, or output transformer (OPT) blowout from running without a speaker load.

returns.title: Return & Exchange Policy
returns.content: A hassle-free return policy giving you peace of mind when testing gear at home.

details.heading: 1. Return Period
details.text:
• First 7 days: 1-to-1 replacement or full refund if a technical defect arises that cannot be resolved on-site.
• Upgrades: Upgrade to higher-tier models within the first 14 days by covering the difference at preferential terms.

details.heading: 2. Condition for Returns
details.text: Gear must remain in the same condition as received, with original packaging foam, documentation, and all accessories (power cable, tubes, tube cage).

details.heading: 3. Refund Processing
details.text: Full refund will be wired to your bank account within 24-48 hours after our technicians inspect and verify the returned equipment.

payment.title: Payment & Deposit Policy
payment.content: Multiple payment methods and safe deposit reservations with automated verification.

details.heading: 1. Bank Transfer 24/7
details.text: Direct bank wire to the store's verified account with auto-generated order codes for immediate order processing.

details.heading: 2. Cash on Delivery (COD)
details.text: Available for accessories and orders under 10,000,000 VND. For high-value tube amplifiers, a 10-20% deposit is required before packaging and dispatch.

details.heading: 3. Reservation Deposits
details.text: For rare or unique vintage units, customers may place a reservation deposit to hold the item for 3-7 days. All deposit details are transparently logged and trackable.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Protection of personal information and transaction records for all audio enthusiasts.

details.heading: 1. Data Collection
details.text: We only collect your name, phone number, shipping address, and email to fulfill orders, manage warranties, and provide status notifications.

details.heading: 2. No Third-Party Sharing
details.text: We strictly guarantee never to sell, trade, or share your data with third parties, except the courier handling your physical parcel.

details.heading: 3. Data Rights
details.text: You may request account data updates or deletions at any time by contacting our hotline or emailing hello@classictubeamps.vn.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: Terms and conditions governing purchases and interactions at Vintage Audio Accessories.

details.heading: 1. Product Authenticity
details.text: All vintage product photos on our website are high-resolution captures of the exact units in stock. Internal component conditions (caps, tubes, transformers) are documented transparently.

details.heading: 2. Order Confirmation
details.text: Our staff will reach out via phone/Zalo to double-check AC voltage (100V vs 220V), speaker pairing specs, and address before shipping.

details.heading: 3. Intellectual Property
details.text: All articles, guides, photography, and demonstration videos are copyrighted property of Vintage Audio Accessories.
